column1: # DATA-vs-ACT classification of every GSP_RM_CONTROL demanded in cap1_coldboot_hermetic.
# Task #179 (replay-conformance). Source of truth: ogkm-580.159.04 (NVIDIA open kernel
# modules 580.159.04) — the driver the bench guest runs. ⚠ Every citation is against that
# bucket   DATA    the reply is the whole answer; params carry [out]; servable from a table
#          ACT     params are all [in]; the reply only acknowledges something that HAPPENED
#          MIXED   params carry both directions AND the call causes a device-side effect
#          UNKNOWN not decidable from this tree — the reason is in `note`
# ⊘ A control's NAME does not decide this. Each row was decided from the params struct and
#   from what the CPU-side caller does with the params AFTER the RPC returns.
#   is a ONE-WAY witness: present ⇒ DATA. Absent ⇒ nothing; most of RM predates the flag.
#   `CACHEABLE_BY_INPUT` (0x20000) ⇒ DATA but the table must be keyed on the request params.
# totals: 53 controls — DATA 38, ACT 11, MIXED 1, UNKNOWN 3. Cited: 50/53 (94.3%).

# totals: 53 controls — DATA 26, ACT 4, MIXED 1, UNKNOWN 22.
#   UNKNOWN 22/53 (41.5%) — ALL for one structural reason: the GSS-legacy space
#   (bit 15 of the cmd, RM_GSS_LEGACY_MASK). ogkm has no #define, no struct, no
#   NVOC export and no interpretation for ANY of them, in EITHER tree.
#   Hardware-refused on this boot: 9 unconditional + 2 conditional = 11.
# ⊘ `out_vs_in = SAME` in the trace is NOT evidence of ACT. Measured
#   display active") and 0x20801813 (documented [out] counters are all 0 on a
#   healthy link). SAME means "this call added nothing", never "returns nothing".
